request.missing_relation: Whether Parkinson home/remote voice studies have directly compared one recording with same-session replicate aggregation for repeatability or clinically anchored motor-change alerts.
request.query: (Parkinson OR Parkinson's) AND (voice OR speech) AND (home OR remote) AND (repeatability OR test-retest OR replicate) AND (clinical change OR motor score)
request.change_if_found: If a directly matching study exists, cite it as prior work and narrow the contribution to a distinct alert operating-point comparison or replicate protocol only if that distinction is supported. If search results are absent or titles-only, keep world-literature novelty unverified and retain the study as a proposal rather than calling it novel.

result.scope: Crossref metadata; original abstracts only when present
